ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with near-zero high-intensity (white) pixel distribution on the visible ventral surface; estimated macro ratio <1:50.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with a wide obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees and minimal pixel depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with low-amplitude peaks and valleys; highest frequency of variations observed on the distal 20% of the left and right lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep with a linear-to-slight-convex trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in tip morphology; the left distal tip exhibits a more jagged, irregular pixel cluster compared to the tapered, smoother profile of the right distal tip.
